name: General explainer
audience: Curious English-speaking adults seeking a clear answer to a concrete question.
viewer_promise: Understand one useful mechanism through evidence and visual demonstrations.
topic_scope: Answerable questions within a topic selected by the user; verify sources appropriate to that domain.

editorial.tone: Clear, curious, conversational; avoid unsupported certainty.

visual.style_lock: simple readable shapes, restrained palette, no photorealism, 16:9 widescreen.
